content_zh:
“你的意思是说，我打游戏就是为了要追那个什么秦少？“博九喝了口豆浆，挑眉问道：”谁给你的这种错觉？“
陈晓东很心痛的摇头：“少爷，都到了这一步了，你骗老王就算了，就不要骗我了，我来博家三年了，还不知道你吗？你什么时候为了一个东西忘寝废食过，除了男人。”
博九：……
“少爷，你就承认了吧。”陈晓东一脸认真的道：“只要你答应夫人进步一名，我是不会给你告密的。”
算了，她就不解释了，越解释越乱。
进步一名这个条件倒是可以答应，博九慵懒的撑着下巴：“我上一次考的多少名？”
陈晓东：“倒数第一。”
博九默了，过了半响才问：“你确定我妈说只让我上升一名？“
“是的，夫人说只要你考到倒数第二，她就给你奖励。“陈晓东神色很坚定！
博九：“这绝对是亲妈，我答应。”倒数第二还不好考吗？她就算物理化学不行，还有英语和数学呢，黑客强项。
陈晓东见博九答应的这么痛快，反而担心了：“夫人还说了，贿赂倒数第二不让他来上学，这种办法不能用，不然奖励作废。”
博九挑眉：“为什么要贿赂，我直接用拳头威胁不是更好？“
“少爷，你别开玩笑了，你连女孩子都打不过，怎么可能打的过男孩子。“陈晓东哈哈哈的笑了起来，朝着博九的肩就拍了一下，那姿势非常像宋小宝！
博九抬眸，很慢很慢的放下了手中的木筷，目光冷冷的扫了他一眼。
陈晓东一下子就给僵了，为什么他会在少爷的身上感觉到杀气？
这不科学！
不过，真的好可怕！
博九倒是也没有怎么样他，毕竟这孩子一直都对自己很好。
老实说起来，她以前到底是有多弱，怎么连女孩子都揍不过，白瞎了这么一副好身材。
不管怎么样，博九还是顶着她张帅气俊美的脸去上学了，一身黑白相间的校服，书包很酷甩在肩上，少年过分白皙的容颜在阳光的照耀下，就如同葱葱玉竹，通透而又疏离。

学校里不少人停下了步子，开始围观。
“你们有没有觉得博九好像变得不太一样了？”
“总感觉……好帅！”

content_en:
"You mean, I play games just to chase that Mr. Qin?" Bo Jiu took a sip of soy milk, raised his eyebrows and asked, "Who gave you this illusion?"
Chen Xiaodong shook his head heartbrokenly: "Young Master, we have come to this point. Just forget about lying to Lao Wang. Don't lie to me anymore. I have been in Bo's house for three years, and I still don't know about you? When have you ever forgotten all your sleep and food for one thing, except for a man?"
Bo Jiu:......
"Master, just admit it." Chen Xiaodong said with a serious face: "As long as you promise Madam to move up one rank, I will not inform you."
Forget it, she won't explain anymore. The more she explains, the more confusing it becomes.
The condition of improving by one place is acceptable. Bo Jiu lazily supported his chin: "How many places did I get in the last exam?"
Chen Xiaodong: "First from last."
Bo Jiu was silent, and after a while he asked: "Are you sure my mother said that I would only be promoted to one rank?"
"Yes, Madam said that as long as you finish second to last in the exam, she will give you a reward." Chen Xiaodong looked very determined!
Bo Jiu: "This is definitely my mother, I promise." Isn't it difficult to take the penultimate exam? Even if she is not good at physics and chemistry, she still has English and mathematics, which are her strengths as a hacker.
Chen Xiaodong became worried when he saw Bo Jiu agreeing so happily: "Madam also said that bribing the second-to-lastest student not to let him come to school cannot be used, otherwise the reward will be invalid."
Bo Jiu raised his eyebrows: "Why bribe? Wouldn't it be better if I just threaten with my fist?"
"Master, stop joking. You can't even beat a girl. How can you beat a boy?" Chen Xiaodong laughed and patted Bo Jiu on the shoulder. His posture was very similar to Song Xiaobao!
Bo Jiu raised his eyes, put down the wooden chopsticks in his hand very slowly, and glanced at him coldly.
Chen Xiaodong was stunned for a moment. Why did he feel murderous intent in the young master?
This is unscientific!
However, it’s really scary!
Bo Jiu didn't do anything to him, after all, this child had always been very kind to him.
To be honest, how weak was she before? How come she couldn't even beat up a girl, so she lost such a good figure for nothing.
No matter what, Bo Jiu went to school with her handsome face, wearing a black and white school uniform, with a cool schoolbag slung over her shoulders. Under the sunlight, the boy's overly fair face was like lush green bamboo, transparent and alienated.
Many people in the school stopped and started to watch.
"Do you feel that Bo Jiu seems to be different?"
"I always feel... so handsome!"
